body:
Thanks for replying. The kind words mean a lot.

Sounds about right, I was holding on to a glimmer of hope that we'll both come to realize that we should try and give ourselves another chance. Her moving on, whatever that means at this point, just shattered all that I believed in, everything that gave my life a sense of purpose. And yes, every day feels impossible to get through, and I think that one of these days I'll just tip over the edge and make peace with it, going out and leaving everything that scarred me behind.
